text: Over the past 30 days, several visitors noted issues with the food quality and limited menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. One critical review specifically mentioned bland and frozen potato salad, an unheated grilled cheese sandwich, and a lack of side choices like chips or fries. Wait times were also mentioned by a few visitors, though less frequently. Service and atmosphere received minimal comments, and value was noted only once. Overall, the average rating remains above four and a half stars, but food offerings appear to need attention.

windows.60: Visitor reviews over the last 60 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported long wait times and limited menu availability, with some noting that the kitchen was frequently backed up and only grab-and-go options were offered late in the day. Many found the food quality inconsistent or below expectations, citing bland or poorly prepared items, and several mentioned that prices did not match portion sizes or quality. While the library itself received some positive remarks, the café’s menu range, value, and service were common points of dissatisfaction that need attention.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the past 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Many guests found the menu limited and the food quality below expectations, with complaints about overpriced items and small portions. Service delays and long wait times were also noted, including periods when the kitchen was not taking orders. While the library itself receives positive remarks, the café’s menu choices, pricing, and operational logistics require attention to improve visitor satisfaction.
